name: Gated Second-Order Trajectory
definition: A method to model the position of each Gaussian at time t using a second-order motion model around a canonical time, allowing for constant velocity and acceleration terms, gated by a binary switch to distinguish static from dynamic Gaussians.
summary: Gated Second-Order Trajectory models 3D Gaussian motion using explicit kinematics and a binary gate, enabling static caching and avoiding per-frame neural inference.
